question: Who was the first Indian woman Odissi dancer to be awarded the Padma Vibhushan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonal Mansingh**.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonal Mansingh** is a Bharatanatyam and **Odissi** dancer from India who was born on **April 30, 1944**.
 
• The** President** of India has proposed her for election as a **Rajya Sabha** member.
 
• In **1992** and **2003**, she received the **Padma Bhushan** and **Padma Vibhushan** awards as the youngest laureate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Facts about Padma awards**

 
 
• The Padma **Vibhushan**, Padma **Bhusan,** and Padma **Shri awards **recognize extraordinary and distinguished service, **high-caliber** distinguished service, and **outstanding service **in any discipline, respectively.
 
• Every year, on the occasion of **Republic Day**, the prizes are **announced**.
 
 
 
• **Sitara Devi,** also known as **Dhanlakshm,** was an Indian **traditional Kathak dancer**, singer, and actress who lived from November **8, 1920,** to November **25, 2014**.
 
• Theosophist, **Bharatanatyam** dancer and animal rights advocate **Rukmini Devi Arundale** was from India.
 
 
• She also danced and choreographed for this kind of **classical dance**.
 
 
 
• A well-known Indian Kathak dancer, **Shovana Narayan** works for the **Indian Audit **and **Accounts Service** as a career official.** **
 
 
• **Winner** of the **Padma Shri **One of the world's top **Kathak dancers** is Shovana Narayan.
